text:
Lena Ortiz: Alderwell Clinical wants a 4-week POC to validate alder-32b-clin-v1 for discharge summary generation. They require HIPAA-ready hosting, per-customer KMS with BYOK, no logs stored by default, and the ability to run in their AWS account (VPC). Also asked for a pricing estimate for up to 2M input tokens/week.
Tom Becker: Noted. Does the model use rotary or ALiBi? That affects long-context perf. Any info on tokenizer/seq split?
Lena Ortiz: They report a lot of concatenated notes -> typical input 1.2k tokens, outputs 150-400 tokens. Some sessions hit 10k context (they expect us to chain KV cache). Model artifact: s3://alderwell/models/alder-32b-clin-v1.tar.gz (access granted).
Samir Rao: Ops: for 10k we should consider chunked KV + interleaved shards. Quantization options: q4_k_m seems stable for this family; q4_0 had quality regressions in our internal eval. Suggest perf with q4_k_m + kv-prune policy.
Nina Vu: For Private/VPC install — we'll need a 2-week install window and infra review. Short POC path: start with Redwood Dedicated in a dedicated subnet + VPC peering, then migrate to their VPC if they sign the DPA. We'll need to confirm HSM/KMS integration for BYOK.
legal-bot: Action required: Complete DPA + SOC2 artifacts and complete 42 security questionnaire items. Upload to legal intake: <link-legal/Alderwell-POC>.
Tom Becker: Quick checks for SEs: run model inspect and tokenizer diff, then two perf jobs (q4_k_m kv and fp16 baseline). Snippet: 
```
redwoodctl model inspect --model s3://alderwell/models/alder-32b-clin-v1.tar.gz
redwoodctl perf run --model alder-32b-clin-v1 --quant q4_k_m --kv interleaved --seq-len 10240 --batch 1
```
Samir Rao: Note: alder-32b-clin-v1 uses a custom GELU variant which causes slower kernels on our Triton stack. Add XLA path run. Also test with prefix caching on repeated patient headers.
Lena Ortiz: They also want a clause about data deletion at end of trial and confirmation we won't use PII for model training. Include that in the DPA.
Nina Vu: I'll scope Dedicated sizing: likely 3x A100-80GB with kv shards, enable prefix/KV caching and kv-pruning LRU. If latency SLO is 400ms p95 for 1.2k/400 outputs we should be fine on q4_k_m; 10k traces may push p95 to 700-1kms. We should present two routes: latency-optimized (13b-slim fallback) and quality-optimized (32b q4_k_m).
Samir Rao: Routing plan: canary 5% to 32b cluster, auto-fallback to 13b-slim for requests exceeding 450ms or for health-errors. Add tracing and per-route cost tagging so billing matches the POC estimate.
infra-bot: Created ticket POC-7219: "Alderwell alder-32b-clin-v1 POC - HIPAA, BYOK, perf". Assigned: eng-runtime, sales-eng, legal. Link: <internal/POC-7219>.
Tom Becker: Pricing rough: If they do 2M input tokens/week (~8M tokens total for 4 weeks) plus outputs ~3M tokens, estimate hosted+Ddedicated blended cost. Samir/Ops, can you draft a credit/commit option vs pure usage estimate?
Samir Rao: I'll sketch three options: (1) Usage-only (hosted) with uplift for HIPAA and BYOK, (2) 4-week Dedicated reservation with credits and burst to hosted, (3) Private deployment quote (longer lead, infra fee). Post numbers by EOD Monday.
Nina Vu: I'll start the install checklist in parallel and flag any IP/network blockers for their infra team. Need contact person and preferred AWS account details.
Lena Ortiz: I'll send them the security questionnaire and schedule kick-off call Tue 9am ET. SEs, please upload a short perf summary and the tokenizer diff prior to the call.
Tom Becker: On it. Will run tokenizer diff and perf today and post logs.
Samir Rao: Will validate q4_k_m outputs on hallucination regression set and report rouge/precision deltas.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks all :rocket: — adding Alderwell contacts to the thread and linking the calendar invite.
